browser-detect.js and browser-update.js are served untransformed by the Rails asset pipeline; the recipe pins their bytes by sha256 and adds an identity source map (map-tools/identity-map.cjs) because upstream ships none.

nonBuildScripts.provenance: Runtime locale bundle: app/controllers/extra_locales_controller.rb#show renders JsLocaleHelper.output_locale from config/locales/client.*.yml (lib/js_locale_helper.rb); the URL digest is SHA1(CACHE_VERSION|body).
Theme translation data stored in a JavascriptCache row; app/models/theme_field.rb#process_translation sets source_map to nil, so app/controllers/theme_javascripts_controller.rb never publishes a map.
Runtime SVG sprite: app/controllers/svg_sprite_controller.rb renders window.__svg_sprite from SvgSprite.bundle (lib/svg_sprite.rb), inlined as data.

plugins/footnote/plugin.rb registers vendor/javascripts/markdown-it-footnote.js as a vendored asset; lib/plugin/instance.rb#write_extra_js! concatenates it verbatim into app/assets/generated/footnote/plugins/footnote_extra.js. Vendor, generated and served bytes are identical.
